harnesses.description: The harnesses the project is set up for, each named for its binary. codefall still reads claude-code and antigravity, the names claude and agy had before, and codefall upgrade rewrites them. A name appears once.

agents.description: Who codefall reaches for when a verb needs another reader, by the harness the session is running in (ADR-009.2). Each entry is for one active agent, one of the five harness names or default, and holds a review list and a consult list, each the agents to try in order until one answers. A list left out means the default entry's list; a default entry left out means the current harness's own subagent. Absent means one default entry whose two lists each hold current, which codefall init writes explicitly.

activeAgent.description: The harness a session is running in when this entry applies, or default for every harness without an entry of its own. Each value appears at most once.

review.description: Who reviews for a session in this harness, tried in order: a run skips an agent this machine cannot start and moves on when one fails.

consult.description: Who is asked when a run in this harness cannot settle a question on its own, tried in order. A consult proposes; the session decides.

harnessConfig.description: How each harness is called when an agent runs on it. A key that is a harness name configures that harness; any other key is a variant whose harness field names the binary, so one project can call Codex through a provider for review and directly for consult. An agent's harness may name either. A harness with no block runs bare. The shared script that starts a harness reads the block at run time.

harness.description: The binary a variant runs, one of the five harness names; never current. Refused on a block whose key is already a harness name.

modelFlag.description: The flag the shared script passes the model with. The script's built-in flag for the harness is the fallback.

provider.description: The harness's own provider name, which the script turns into that harness's switch.

env.description: A shell command whose standard output is evaluated before the harness starts, so export lines take effect.

postToPullRequest.description: Whether codefall-review may post its findings to a pull request. Absent means false.

local.description: The project's local-environment commands, each a shell command run from the project root (ADR-005).

start.description: Brings up what the project needs running locally. Idempotent.

update.description: Makes the local environment match the checkout. Idempotent; may assume start has run.

test.description: What the project has declared about its test cases: where they live, and which runners are installed (ADR-007).

dir.description: The testing root, relative to the directory holding .codefall/. codefall init asks for it and defaults to testing.

runners.description: The spec runners the project has installed, written by codefall-equip rather than by hand.

harness.description: What runs the agent, in one of three forms: a harness name (agy, claude, codex, muse, opencode); current, a subagent of the harness the session is running in, which is always runnable; or a harnessConfig key, which names a harness and how it is called.

model.description: The model to ask that harness for, passed to it as written.
